title: Marcos swears in Chief Justice Zalameda in Malacañang
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. swore in Supreme Court Chief Justice Rodil Zalameda in a ceremonial oath-taking ceremony in Malacañang on Monday, November 9.
